# Phylogeny {#sec-phylogeny}

::: {.callout-note title="From the exam description"}
Advantages and limitations of different methods.
:::

## Introduction

::: {.callout-warning title="To be written"}
Short introduction: trees as hypotheses of descent; distance, parsimony,
maximum-likelihood and Bayesian methods; substitution models; assessing
support; phylogenomics and the tree of life.
:::

## Key concepts

- Tree terminology: rooted/unrooted, topology, branch lengths, clades, outgroups; number of possible trees
- Distance methods: UPGMA (and the molecular-clock assumption), neighbour joining
- Maximum parsimony: Fitch algorithm; long-branch attraction
- Maximum likelihood: Felsenstein's pruning algorithm, tree search heuristics (RAxML, IQ-TREE)
- Bayesian inference: priors, MCMC, posterior probabilities (MrBayes)
- Substitution models: JC69, K80, HKY, GTR; rate heterogeneity (Γ); model selection
- Support: bootstrap, posterior probabilities, approximate tests
- Alignment uncertainty and its effect on trees
- Phylogenomics: concatenation vs. coalescent/species-tree methods; incomplete lineage sorting; HGT and phylogenetic networks
- The tree of life and its root(s)

## Key papers

::: {.callout-tip}
★ = mandatory in earlier reading lists.
:::

### Reviews — start here

- @yang2012 — molecular phylogenetics: principles and practice.
- @kapli2020 — phylogenetic tree building in the genomic age.
- @delsuc2005 — phylogenomics and the reconstruction of the tree of life.
- @steel2000 — parsimony, likelihood and the role of models.

### Classic methods

- @fitch1971 — minimum change on a given topology (parsimony).
- ★ @felsenstein1981 — maximum-likelihood trees from DNA sequences.
- @felsenstein1985 — confidence limits on phylogenies: the bootstrap.
- @saitou1987 — neighbour joining.
- @huelsenbeck2001 — Bayesian inference of phylogeny.
- @thorne1991 — an evolutionary model for maximum-likelihood alignment (TKF91).

### Alignment uncertainty

- @redelings2005 — joint Bayesian estimation of alignment and phylogeny.
- @wong2008 — alignment uncertainty and genomic analysis.

### Software

- @stamatakis2014 — RAxML.
- @minh2020 — IQ-TREE 2.
- @ronquist2012 — MrBayes 3.2.

### Tree of life

- @hug2016 — a new view of the tree of life.
